title: Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity
title_zh: 保守元智能体搜索：非平稳性下的架构自适应

paragraphs.en: Automated design of agentic systems is typically evaluated on static task suites with immediate scalar rewards. Deployed systems face persistent shift, delayed dependent feedback, correlated component failures, and costly architecture changes. We formalize meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints, and introduce Conservative Meta-Agent Search ( Cmas ). Throughout, meta-agent denotes the entire outer loop: proposer, compiler, evaluator, gate, and rollback controller. Cmas retrieves archived architectures and proposes typed graph edits, then scores each against the incumbent by paired shadow replay under common random numbers. Component credit is interventional. Promotion requires an empirically calibrated, variance-penalized simultaneous score above a pre-specified margin, and is followed by a simulated canary stage and pre-specified rollback. Backtested return cannot certify meta-level skill, so we introduce MetaInvest-Bench , a regime-switching simulator whose specified worker competence makes a surrogate-optimal architecture computable, with leakage-controlled replay, adversarial governance tracks, and five reusable negative controls. Financial streams give an instrumented, risk-sensitive test of meta-level generalization; we claim no alpha. Across 96 streams, Cmas cuts normalized mean surrogate dynamic-oracle regret from 0.116 to 0.104 and raises held-out utility from 0.44 to 0.48 over the strongest adaptive common-budget reimplementation; when extra workers add no value, it contracts to near-single-agent teams. Its deployment inference cost is ∼ 6 % {\sim}6\% lower, though its search-inclusive token cost is the highest of the methods compared. The observed per-update false-promotion rate is 3.4% against a nominal 5% target, and 4.8% in a sealed rerun. The statistical ingredients are standard. The calibration is empirical: it concerns an update-level replay statistic on an author-designed benchmark, and guarantees neither full-utility improvement, nor absence of simulated canary-stage harm, nor sequence-level error control.

paragraphs.en: Meta-agents act on agentic systems. They design harnesses, optimize compound workflows, allocate resources, and supervise workers. paragraphs.en: Architecture is therefore a decision variable that should track the regime (Figure 1 ). Investment systems expose non-stationarity, delayed and dependent feedback, correlated component errors, switching costs, and tail-risk constraints. Finance is useful here as an instrumented, risk-sensitive test of meta-level generalization and conservative update evaluation. Backtested return is not intrinsically persuasive [ 6 , 7 , 13 ] . What is missing is (i) a controlled benchmark whose surrogate-optimal worker architecture is computable and changes over time, and (ii) a method that screens candidate updates under noisy, delayed feedback [ 17 , 15 , 12 , 2 ] . An update whose simulator-evaluated mean improvement is at most the promotion margin is a false promotion , the meta-level analogue of a false discovery and a near-neutral change; Table 2 separates it from the outcomes that do make the system worse.

paragraphs.en: Three contributions follow. (1) We formulate agent-architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement over typed architectures, with a structural distance (Eq. ( 1 )) as switching cost, delayed dependent utility (Eq. ( 2 )), hard eligibility constraints, an explicit false-promotion target, and meta-level generalization (Definition 1 ) as the scored quantity. (2) Cmas couples archive-conditioned typed edits, paired candidate–incumbent replay under common random numbers, interventional Shapley-style [ 34 , 35 ] credit fed back to the proposer, and a conservative promotion-and-rollback gate. The statistical ingredients are standard; the contribution is their integration. Proposition 1 states only the idealized conditions under which such a gate would control family-wise false promotion, and Section 4 scopes the departures. paragraphs.en: Automated design and optimization of agent systems. ADAS, AgentSquare/AFlow, MaAS/AutoMaAS, and GEPA search executable programs, workflows, architectures, or prompts [ 3 , 14 , 19 , 20 , 9 , 1 ] . GPTSwarm and G-Designer optimize communication graphs [ 23 , 18 ] . Adaptive Auto-Harness directly studies sustained harness construction and routing on open-ended, heterogeneous, non-stationary streams [ 43 ] . HarnessAudit evaluates trajectory-level boundary and information-flow compliance, while SafeHarness integrates verification, privilege control, degradation, and rollback across the agent lifecycle [ 44 , 45 ] . What Cmas makes first-class is repeated candidate–incumbent replacement, paired replay on shared randomness, update-level promotion calibration, switching cost, and a reversible simulated canary stage. The closest systems route at solve time and leave the deployed incumbent in place [ 43 , 20 ] , gate on candidate quality without a paired incumbent comparison or rollback [ 39 , 40 ] , or audit and secure execution without an update-level false-promotion estimand [ 44 , 45 ] ; full comparisons in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体系统的自动化设计与优化。 ADAS、AgentSquare/AFlow、MaAS/AutoMaAS 和 GEPA 搜索可执行程序、工作流、架构或提示词 [ 3 , 14 , 19 , 20 , 9 , 1 ] 。 GPTSwarm 和 G-Designer 优化通信图 [ 23 , 18 ] 。 Adaptive Auto-Harness 直接研究在开放式、异构、非平稳数据流上的持续框架构建与路由 [ 43 ] 。 HarnessAudit 评估轨迹层面的边界与信息流合规性，而 SafeHarness 在智能体生命周期中整合了验证、权限控制、降级与回滚 [ 44 , 45 ] 。 Cmas 将以下内容作为一等公民：重复的候选者—现任者替换、基于共享随机性的成对重放、更新级别的晋升校准、切换成本，以及可逆的模拟金丝雀阶段。 最接近的系统要么在求解时进行路由而保持已部署的现任者不变 [ 43 , 20 ] ，要么基于候选者质量进行门控但没有成对的现任者比较或回滚 [ 39 , 40 ] ，要么在不具备更新级别的虚假晋升估计量的情况下进行审计与安全执行 [ 44 , 45 ] ；完整比较见附录 I 。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. Seven Track A methods: a strong single agent with self-consistency under the same per-decision deployment budget cap; a fixed full committee; a rule-based regime router; a LinUCB bandit [ 29 ] over a 15-architecture menu (partially logged; Table 6 ); AFlow-style workflow search [ 14 , 19 ] ; MaAS/AutoMaAS-style adaptive selection [ 20 , 9 ] , the strongest adaptive competitor and what “best adaptive baseline” denotes throughout; and GEPA-style prompt-only optimization [ 1 ] . All are scored against the same surrogate dynamic oracle and share data packets, z k z_{k} , worker library, risk layer, model pool, and equal search-inclusive budget caps (Shapley and paired-replay compute counted), with no information advantage. These are our reimplementations, not official releases, so every superiority claim is scoped to common-budget reimplementations under a shared risk layer . Each method’s defining search mechanism is retained; only what the shared environment forces is changed (retained/changed detail in Appendix C ). Routing the best baseline’s proposals through our gate still reaches 0.45 OOD utility against Cmas ’s 0.48 (Table 7 ), bounding the risk that a weak reimplementation drives the result.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 七种 Track A 方法：在相同的每决策部署预算上限下、采用自一致性的强单智能体；固定的完整委员会；基于规则的机制路由器；在 15 种架构菜单上运行的 LinUCB 多臂老虎机 [ 29 ]（部分记录；表 6 ）；AFlow 风格的工作流搜索 [ 14 , 19 ] ；MaAS/AutoMaAS 风格的自适应选择 [ 20 , 9 ] ，这是最强的自适应竞争者，也是全文中「最佳自适应基线」所指的方法；以及 GEPA 风格的仅提示词优化 [ 1 ] 。 所有方法均在同一个代理动态神谕下评分，并共享数据包、z k z_{k} 、工作者库、风险层、模型池以及同等的含搜索预算上限（计入 Shapley 与成对重放的计算开销），且不享有任何信息优势。 这些是我们的重新实现版本，而非官方发布版本，因此所有优越性声明均限定于共享风险层下、相同预算的重新实现版本。 每个方法的核心搜索机制均予以保留；仅改变共享环境所强制要求的部分（保留与修改的细节见附录 C ）。 将最佳基线的提案通过我们的门控进行路由，仍能达到 0.45 的 OOD 效用，而 Cmas 为 0.48（表 7 ），这限制了因重新实现较弱而主导结果的风险。

paragraphs.en: Statistics. Nested walk-forward with an untouched final test; search is confined to training/validation intervals. The unit of replication is a stream (96 = = 12 seeds × \times 8 schedules), with paired stream-level block-bootstrap CIs as the primary inference and schedule-clustered hierarchical intervals as a sensitivity analysis (Tables 1 , 7 – 10 ). With only eight top-level schedules, clustered intervals are read cautiously and significance rests on the paired stream-level difference under common random numbers; clustering widens intervals without overturning the ablations (e.g. no-paired-evaluation OOD utility [ 0.42 , 0.48 ] [0.42,0.48] ; Table 10 ). paragraphs.en: Cmas treats meta-agent search as reversible sequential deployment, and MetaInvest-Bench makes “did it adapt for the right reason?” measurable. Together they give a bounded, auditable framework for deciding when to replace an incumbent. That is not proof that meta-agent updates are safe.
paragraphs.zh: Cmas 将元智能体搜索视为可逆的顺序部署，而 MetaInvest-Bench 则使「它是否基于正确的理由进行了适应？」这一问题变得可度量。 二者共同提供了一个有界、可审计的框架，用于决定何时替换现有的智能体。 这并不能证明元智能体更新是安全的。

Three premises of Proposition 1 are not established for the overlapping evaluation protocol: (i) cross-update disjointness fails because 26-week windows at monthly cadence overlap, so proposals condition on outcomes contained in earlier evaluation windows; (ii) the implemented score drops the Bernstein range correction and plugs an estimated V ^ k , c \widehat{V}_{k,c} and effective block count B eff B_{\mathrm{eff}} into a variance-only form, which carries no finite-sample concentration theorem under dependence (Remark 1); and (iii) the paired deltas are winsorized at their validation-calibrated 99% quantile (binding in 1.2% of blocks, mainly volatility shocks), while the configuration constant M = 0.15 M{=}0.15 is a raw-utility-scale bound, loose by roughly 4 × 4\times on the paired-delta scale.

paragraphs.en: Primary suite. That gives 96 × 6 = 576 96\times 6=576 governance episodes. The 5/10/25 bps cost levels apply to Track B replay, not to governance. paragraphs.en: Oracle utility is computed by exhaustive search for small graphs and mixed-integer optimization for the larger space. The oracle is a surrogate : it optimizes over the enumerated feasible subset of the pre-specified space (valid DAGs within budget) using the simulator’s specified competence model. In that model, worker outputs enter through their analytic expected utility under the regime’s factor distribution, marginalizing the simulator’s noise terms; no actual LLM executions are involved. Prompt fields and verification nodes are fixed categorical choices in the MIP. Its optimality is exact for this surrogate model, not for arbitrary LLM behavior.

paragraphs.en: Track B detail. Historical evaluation uses two safeguards against documented LLM-backtest leakage [ 6 , 7 , 22 ] : date-controlled replay restricted to information released after each model’s documented training cutoff (for Mixtral the cutoff is undisclosed and January 2024 is used, so genuine post-training-cutoff status cannot be guaranteed for that model), and counterfactual structural replay that fits a factor model, scrambles identities and calendars, and resamples factor/residual paths preserving cross-asset dependence. Agents never receive real tickers, dates, future documents, or web access. Performance is decomposed into market, style, and residual components so passive beta is not counted as skill, and publication lags and vintage data are frozen. The universe spans liquid equity, duration, credit, commodity, gold, real-estate, and international ETFs; decisions weekly, updates monthly (a quarterly variant is not evaluated here), costs 5/10/25 bps. Transfer is evaluated on a held-out universe and a different model family. Track B CEQ and factor α \alpha are reported in annualized percent throughout (e.g. Cmas CEQ = 7.8 % =7.8\% ); the cross-window standard deviation over the 18 replay windows is ± 1.1 \pm 1.1 pp.
paragraphs.zh: 轨道 B 的细节。 历史评估使用两项保障措施来防止已记录在案的大语言模型回测泄漏 [ 6 , 7 , 22 ]：其一是受日期控制的重放，仅限于使用每个模型所记录的训练截止日期之后发布的信息（Mixtral 的截止日期未公开，因此采用 2024 年 1 月，故无法保证该模型真正处于训练截止之后的状态）；其二是反事实结构重放，即拟合一个因子模型，打乱标的身份与日历，并在保持跨资产依赖关系的前提下对因子/残差路径进行重采样。 智能体永远不会收到真实股票代码、日期、未来文档或网络访问权限。 业绩被分解为市场、风格与残差成分，从而被动贝塔收益不被计作能力，同时发布滞后与历史版本数据均被冻结。 标的范围涵盖流动性股票、久期、信用、大宗商品、黄金、房地产以及国际 ETF；决策每周进行，更新每月进行（此处不评估季度变体），成本为 5/10/25 个基点。 迁移能力在一个留出标的集合和一个不同的模型家族上进行评估。 轨道 B 的 CEQ 与因子 α \alpha 在全文中均以年化百分比报告（例如 Cmas CEQ = 7.8 % =7.8\% ）；在 18 个重放窗口上的跨窗口标准差为 ± 1.1 \pm 1.1 个百分点。

sents.en: Historical evaluation uses two safeguards against documented LLM-backtest leakage [ 6 , 7 , 22 ] : date-controlled replay restricted to information released after each model’s documented training cutoff (for Mixtral the cutoff is undisclosed and January 2024 is used, so genuine post-training-cutoff status cannot be guaranteed for that model), and counterfactual structural replay that fits a factor model, scrambles identities and calendars, and resamples factor/residual paths preserving cross-asset dependence.
sents.zh: 历史评估使用两项保障措施来防止已记录在案的大语言模型回测泄漏 [ 6 , 7 , 22 ]：其一是受日期控制的重放，仅限于使用每个模型所记录的训练截止日期之后发布的信息（Mixtral 的截止日期未公开，因此采用 2024 年 1 月，故无法保证该模型真正处于训练截止之后的状态）；其二是反事实结构重放，即拟合一个因子模型，打乱标的身份与日历，并在保持跨资产依赖关系的前提下对因子/残差路径进行重采样。

sents.en: Agents never receive real tickers, dates, future documents, or web access.
sents.zh: 智能体永远不会收到真实股票代码、日期、未来文档或网络访问权限。

sents.en: Performance is decomposed into market, style, and residual components so passive beta is not counted as skill, and publication lags and vintage data are frozen.
sents.zh: 业绩被分解为市场、风格与残差成分，从而被动贝塔收益不被计作能力，同时发布滞后与历史版本数据均被冻结。

sents.en: The universe spans liquid equity, duration, credit, commodity, gold, real-estate, and international ETFs; decisions weekly, updates monthly (a quarterly variant is not evaluated here), costs 5/10/25 bps.
sents.zh: 标的范围涵盖流动性股票、久期、信用、大宗商品、黄金、房地产以及国际 ETF；决策每周进行，更新每月进行（此处不评估季度变体），成本为 5/10/25 个基点。

sents.en: Transfer is evaluated on a held-out universe and a different model family.
sents.zh: 迁移能力在一个留出标的集合和一个不同的模型家族上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Baseline fidelity: retained vs. changed. Every comparison method is a common-interface reimplementation, not an official release, and all comparative claims in the paper are scoped accordingly. Retained for each method is its defining search mechanism: AFlow-style keeps graph-edit search with lookahead; MaAS/AutoMaAS-style keeps supernet optimization over discrete architectural choices; GEPA-style keeps reflective prompt mutation with tournament selection (operators, depths and population sizes below). Changed , and only where the shared environment forces it: (i) the identical 0.85M-token/update search-inclusive budget cap; (ii) the common typed worker interface o i , t o_{i,t} , so that every method emits the same schema; (iii) the immutable risk projection Π 𝒞 t \Pi_{\mathcal{C}_{t}} and authorization layer, which no method may bypass; (iv) the common three-model pool and worker library; and (v) the identical per-decision deployment budget cap. Information available is the same for all methods: the pre-decision descriptor z k z_{k} , the same data packets, seeds, market paths and tool responses, and no access to the latent regime s t s_{t} or to evaluator oracle labels. Two measurements bound the residual risk that a weak reimplementation drives the headline result: routing the strongest baseline’s proposals through the Cmas evaluator and gate still reaches 0.45 OOD utility against Cmas ’s 0.48 (Table 7 ), and the random/evolutionary proposer control in the same table separates proposal quality from gate calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 基线保真度：保留的部分与修改的部分。 每种对比方法都是基于统一接口的重新实现，而非官方发布版本，论文中的所有对比性结论均以此为限定范围。 每种方法保留其定义性的搜索机制：AFlow 风格保留带前瞻的图编辑搜索；MaAS/AutoMaAS 风格保留对离散架构选择的超网优化；GEPA 风格保留带锦标赛选择的反思式提示词变异（算子、深度与种群规模见下文）。 修改仅发生在共享环境所强制要求之处：(i) 完全相同的每轮更新含搜索在内 0.85M token 预算上限；(ii) 统一的类型化 worker 接口 o i , t o_{i,t}，使每种方法输出相同的模式；(iii) 不可绕过的不可变风险投影 Π 𝒞 t \Pi_{\mathcal{C}_{t}} 与授权层，任何方法都不得绕过；(iv) 统一的三模型池与 worker 库；以及 (v) 完全相同的每决策部署预算上限。 所有方法可获取的信息相同：决策前描述符 z k z_{k}、相同的数据包、种子、市场路径与工具响应，且无法访问潜在市场状态 s t s_{t} 或评估器的预言标签。 两项测量界定了弱重新实现可能主导核心结论的残余风险：将最强基线的提案通过 Cmas 评估器与门控处理后仍达到 0.45 的 OOD 效用，而 Cmas 为 0.48（表 7）；且同表中的随机/演化式提案生成器对照实验将提案质量与门控校准区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The infeasible-coalition imputation used in credit estimation shrinks the estimated credit of components whose removal breaks compilation toward the incumbent’s level rather than measuring their true marginal value. The direction and size of the resulting bias depend on the repair rule, which we treat as a design choice (an alternative repair rule is evaluated in Appendix C ). Alternative credit repair. paragraphs.en: Cmas is not uniformly best. It underperforms the static rule router in 14 of 96 streams, predominantly during prolonged Range regimes, where switching costs and exploration penalties outweigh the benefit of adaptation and a fixed cheap policy is hard to beat. The gate is not infallible in either direction. In Stream 42, a tail-risk specialist was promoted immediately before a sudden volatility crush. paragraphs.en: Metric details. Adaptation delay is right-censored at eight post-transition updates; a static method can therefore receive a finite capped delay. Selection accuracy uses exact equality with the surrogate-optimal architecture, so functionally equivalent or near-optimal graphs count as mismatches; normalized regret is the primary metric. OOD normalization uses frozen training minima/maxima without clipping test values.
paragraphs.zh: 指标细节。 适应延迟在转换后的八次更新处进行右删失；因此，静态方法可以得到一个有限的、设有上限的延迟值。 选择准确率采用与代理最优架构的严格相等判定，因此功能等价或接近最优的图都计为不匹配；归一化遗憾值是主要指标。 OOD 归一化使用冻结的训练最小值/最大值，且不对测试值进行截断。

paragraphs.en: Failure modes of the oversight itself. Oversight can fail in four ways. Automation bias: a reviewer presented with a passing score and a plausible hypothesis may approve without inspecting the diff. Rubber-stamping turns routine sign-off into a formality, and is likelier the higher the promotion rate, which is one reason the 42% incumbent-retention rate matters. Evaluator misspecification: if the objective is wrong, the gate faithfully certifies the wrong thing, which is exactly what the return-only probe of RQ7 demonstrates. Specification error in the immutable layer completes the list; constraints protect only if correctly written, and nothing in Cmas detects a wrong constraint.
paragraphs.zh: 监督本身的失效模式。 监督可能以四种方式失效。 自动化偏见：面对通过分数和看似合理的假设，审查者可能不加检查差异就直接批准。 走过场式的盖章使例行签署流于形式，而且通过率越高越容易发生，这也是为什么 42% 的在位者保留率很重要的原因之一。 评估者误设：如果目标本身是错的，这个关口就会忠实地认证错误的东西，这正是 RQ7 的仅回报探针所展示的。 不可变层中的规约错误补全了这份清单；只有正确编写，约束才能起到保护作用，而 Cmas 中没有任何机制能检测出错误的约束。

sents.en: Evaluator misspecification: if the objective is wrong, the gate faithfully certifies the wrong thing, which is exactly what the return-only probe of RQ7 demonstrates.
sents.zh: 评估者误设：如果目标本身是错的，这个关口就会忠实地认证错误的东西，这正是 RQ7 的仅回报探针所展示的。

sents.en: Specification error in the immutable layer completes the list; constraints protect only if correctly written, and nothing in Cmas detects a wrong constraint.
sents.zh: 不可变层中的规约错误补全了这份清单；只有正确编写，约束才能起到保护作用，而 Cmas 中没有任何机制能检测出错误的约束。

paragraphs.en: Misuse. A meta-agent search loop is objective-agnostic. The same machinery could optimize agent fleets for surveillance, manipulation, or exploitative coordination; scale a harmful objective more cheaply; search around an imperfect safety evaluator, since a gate that screens on a measured statistic will also find architectures that satisfy the statistic without satisfying its intent; or produce architectures whose complexity obscures accountability. The parsimony tie-break and the bounded edit set mitigate the last of these, but do not address the first three, which are governance rather than technical problems.
paragraphs.zh: 误用。 元智能体搜索循环是目标无关的。 同一套机制可以用来为监控、操纵或剥削性协调优化智能体集群；以更低的成本扩展有害目标；围绕不完善的安全评估器进行搜索，因为一个基于某项度量统计进行筛选的关卡同样会找到满足该统计但不满足其意图的架构；或者产生其复杂性会掩盖问责的架构。 简洁性决胜规则和有界编辑集可以缓解最后一种情况，但无法解决前三种，而这些属于治理问题而非技术问题。

paragraphs.en: On the optimization side, DSPy compiles declarative pipelines and GEPA evolves prompts reflectively, while Trace generalizes backpropagation-style credit to computational graphs [ 24 , 1 , 25 ] ; Meta-Harness searches full harness code with prior traces [ 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在优化方面，DSPy 编译声明式流水线，GEPA 以反思方式演化提示词，而 Trace 将反向传播式的信用分配泛化到计算图 [ 24 , 1 , 25 ] ；Meta-Harness 利用先前的轨迹搜索完整的测试环境代码 [ 5 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Concurrent 2026 work studies gated harness evolution separating LLM proposals from deterministic crediting [ 39 ] , automated harness optimization [ 40 ] , online adaptation for self-improving agents [ 41 ] , robust agentic-system learning [ 42 ] , and sustained construction/routing over open-ended non-stationary streams [ 43 ] ; Cmas differs in targeting repeated candidate–incumbent replacement under non-stationarity, with paired incumbent comparison, rollback, and false-promotion measurement first-class (Tables 4 – 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 2026 年的并行工作研究了门控式 harness 演化，将 LLM 提案与确定性信用分配相分离 [ 39 ]、自动化 harness 优化 [ 40 ]、面向自我提升智能体的在线适应 [ 41 ]、鲁棒的智能体系统学习 [ 42 ]，以及在开放式非平稳数据流上的持续构建/路由 [ 43 ]；Cmas 的不同之处在于，它针对非平稳条件下重复的候选—现任者替换，并将成对的现任者比较、回滚以及虚假提升度量作为一等公民（表 4 – 5 ）。

paragraphs.en: Safe improvement, conservative exploration, and anytime-valid inference. Our gate belongs to the tradition of high-confidence policy improvement [ 26 ] , safe policy improvement with baseline bootstrapping [ 27 ] , and conservative bandits/exploration bounding performance below a baseline while learning [ 28 ] ; the surrogate dynamic-oracle-regret metric follows non-stationary and switching-cost online learning [ 31 , 32 ] ; our paired shadow replay is related to off-policy evaluation with confidence intervals [ 38 ] ; it pairs candidate and incumbent under common random numbers rather than reweighting a logged policy. Paired replay is available because the simulator and counterfactual replay permit re-execution of candidate and incumbent on the same shocks, the step that importance-weighted, doubly robust, and fitted- Q Q estimators are designed to make unnecessary when only logged data are available. Three properties are new relative to this literature: (a) the action space is typed architectures with structure and a distance (Eq. ( 1 )), not a fixed policy class; (b) candidates are generated adaptively by an LLM proposer , breaking i.i.d. candidate assumptions, which is why the guarantee is conditional on the pool; and (c) evaluation uses LLM execution traces with interventional credit. For open-ended deployment, δ / K \delta/K can be replaced by an anytime-valid schedule or confidence sequence [ 30 ] (Appendix A ).

paragraphs.en: Safety, verification, and meta-level failure. MaMa casts safe agent-system design as a game against a worker-compromising meta-adversary [ 11 ] ; HarnessAudit audits full trajectories for boundary and information-flow violations [ 44 ] , SafeHarness integrates lifecycle verification and rollback [ 45 ] , and other work verifies agent graphs and attributes failures structurally [ 16 ] . The Meta-Agent Challenge argues that task benchmarks do not measure the ability to develop agent systems [ 8 ] . Cmas operationalizes these via false-promotion measurement, worker-compromise tests, trace-level credit, canary deployment, and rollback.
paragraphs.zh: 安全性、验证与元层级失效。 MaMa 将安全的智能体系统设计建模为与一个会攻陷工作智能体的元对手的博弈 [ 11 ] ；HarnessAudit 审计完整轨迹以发现边界与信息流违规 [ 44 ] ，SafeHarness 整合了生命周期验证与回滚 [ 45 ] ，还有其他工作对智能体图进行验证并从结构上归因失效 [ 16 ] 。 元智能体挑战（Meta-Agent Challenge）指出，任务基准并不能衡量开发智能体系统的能力 [ 8 ] 。 Cmas 通过虚假提升度量、工作智能体攻陷测试、轨迹级归因、金丝雀部署与回滚来落实这些要求。

paragraphs.en: Financial agents and evaluation validity. Financial systems include memory-based agents [ 17 ] , trading-firm committees [ 15 ] , prompt adaptation from market feedback [ 12 ] , fine-grained expert teams [ 10 ] , and self-driving portfolios [ 2 ] . Leakage-controlled studies show LLM backtests are inflated by parametric memory and passive factor exposure [ 6 , 7 , 13 , 22 ] ; we therefore make the simulator the primary controlled ground-truth test and treat market replay as external validity only.
paragraphs.zh: 金融智能体与评估有效性。 金融系统包括基于记忆的智能体 [ 17 ] 、交易公司委员会 [ 15 ] 、来自市场反馈的提示自适应 [ 12 ] 、细粒度专家团队 [ 10 ] 以及自动驾驶投资组合 [ 2 ] 。 控制数据泄漏的研究表明，LLM 回测会因参数化记忆和被动因子暴露而被夸大 [ 6 , 7 , 13 , 22 ] ；因此我们将模拟器作为主要的受控真值测试，仅将市场回放视为外部有效性检验。
